title: canvas → slot, plain HTML
blurb: The markup with no template and no shadow root: what the browser does natively, and one script that makes it work.
question: What does a <slot> in a light-DOM canvas do with no shadow root?
result: It projects nothing. A script that moves the matching elements into the canvas makes the markup work.

blankAtEnd.why: the first canvas on this page shows what the browser does with no script, which is nothing
